body:
AUTTAINE COMMANDER
CR 15

XP 51,200
Auttaine fighter 16
LN Medium humanoid (half-construct, human)
Init +5; Senses Perception +1

DEFENSE

AC 27, touch 14, flat-footed 26 (+10 armor, +3 deflection, +1 Dex, +3 natural armor)
hp 156 (16d10+64)
Fort +13, Ref +6, Will +8 (+4 vs. fear); +2 bonus vs. disease, mind-affecting effects, poison, and effects that cause either exhaustion or fatigue.
Resist construct resistances, acid 10

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +2 ominous greatsword +27/+22/+17/+12 (2d6+14/17–20)
Ranged +2 bewildering pepperbox rifle +22/+17/+12/+7 (1d10+4/19–20/x4)
Special Attacks weapon trainings (heavy blades +3, firearms +2, close +1)

STATISTICS

Str 22, Dex 13, Con 17, Int 9, Wis 12, Cha 8
Base Atk +16; CMB +22; CMD 36
Feats Crippling Critical, Critical Focus, Devastating Strike, Far Shot, Gunsmithing, Improved Critical (greatsword), Improved Critical (pepperbox rifle), Improved Initiative, Improved Iron Will, Improved Vital Strike, Iron Will, Lunge, Outflank, Point-Blank Shot, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (pepperbox rifle), Weapon Specialization
Skills Intimidate +20
Languages Common
SQ build points (6—natural armor (3), armor training 4
Gear potion of blur, potion of cure serious wounds, +1 full plate, +2 bewildering pepperbox rifle, +2 ominous greatsword, minor ring of acid resistance, ring of protection +3, magnificent uniform, replete with a dozen medals made of a combination of silver, platinum, and gold worth 3,000 gp in total.
